The 33-pair independent subset enumerations and \(q=9\) example passed via the embedded verifier; no experimental infinity claim.

value.rationale: The source GDRS paper explicitly poses the unresolved question whether orbit count values must differ; the theorem settles strictness, enumerates all strata and their precise coset multiplicities for the natural infinite prime-power-gcd family. These support exact coset-error-frequency statistics rather than only one average count; not a textbook one-line substitution. It does not falsely claim a novel general Fourier identity or more general composite-gcd classification.
